description: U.P. government to use AI cameras, RFID wristbands, and mobile app tracking to monitor 450 million pilgrims at Mahakumbh.
body_lead: The Uttar Pradesh government has planned to use the Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled cameras, Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) wristbands and mobile app tracking to track the headcount of pilgrims at the upcoming Mahakumbh starting in Prayagraj on January 13. The government expects footfall of approximately 450 million devotees at the religious carnival, which is recognised by UNESCO as an Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in which a largest peaceful congregation of pilgrims take a dip in a sacred river. The Mahakumbh will continue for 45 days till February 26, 2025.
